repos.name: CataliftApp
repos.stack_note: one repository combining three kit stacks in subdirectories: react-web in apps/web, go-api in server/ (its own Go module), infra (Terraform part only) in infra/; scaffold each subdirectory from its kit
repos.tech: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query and Table, axios; Go, net/http, pgx, sqlc, goose, slog; Terraform (GCS state), GitLab CI, docker compose, Ops Agent and Cloud Monitoring alert policies
repos.responsibility: The whole of Catalift: the web app, the domain REST APIs (auth, catalogue, listings, export, cost), the rules engine, the job worker, the AI gateway, the infrastructure and the deploy pipeline; owns the database schema

apps.name: Catalift Web
apps.for: sellers uploading launches and reviewers editing, approving and exporting listings

apps.name: Catalift Worker
apps.for: background detection, generation and regeneration jobs

apps.name: Catalift Infra
apps.for: Terraform, compose and proxy config, and the manual deploy and apply jobs
